title: Grade 2 English: Feelings
summary:
1. Feelings (Perasaan):
😊 Happy = Senang
😲 Surprised = Terkejut
😡 Angry = Marah
😟 Worried = Cemas

2. Possessives (Kepunyaan):
⭐ I ➔ My (milikku)
⭐ You ➔ Your (milikmu)
⭐ She ➔ Her (miliknya perempuan)
⭐ He ➔ His (miliknya laki-laki)
⭐ It ➔ Its (milik hewan/benda)
⭐ We ➔ Our (milik kita)
⭐ They ➔ Their (milik mereka)

3. Our 5 Senses (Lima Panca Indera):
👁️ See = Melihat (Eyes / Mata)
👂 Hear = Mendengar (Ears / Telinga)
👃 Smell = Mencium bau (Nose / Hidung)
👅 Taste = Merasakan (Tongue / Lidah)
✋ Touch = Menyentuh (Hands / Tangan)

4. Apostrophes (Tanda Kutip Atas ' ):
📌 Kepunyaan: Tambahkan 's (Contoh: The dog's bone, Mary's book)
📌 Singkatan (Short Words): I am ➔ I'm, He is ➔ He's, We are ➔ We're

5. And, But, Or, Then:
➕ And (Dan): Menggabungkan 2 hal (Contoh: a cat and a dog)
➖ But (Tetapi): Berbeda/Berlawanan (Contoh: small but strong)
🤔 Or (Atau): Memilih (Contoh: milk or juice?)
➡️ Then (Kemudian/Lalu): Apa yang terjadi selanjutnya (Contoh: wash hands, then eat)
